synthesis: The Clarity App-panel dashboard (App\Filament\Pages\Dashboard) gets four changes: (1) rename to "Company Metrics" in both the page header and the sidebar nav item — two distinct Filament code paths; (2) the six existing full-size bar-chart metric widgets (Scan Count, Repossessions/RecoveryCounts, Live Hits, Staging Live Hits, Direct Historical Hits/HistoricalHits, Staging Historical Hits) become compact stat cards showing MTD total, % change vs prior period, and a sparkline, expanding on click to reveal the existing bar chart; (3) the Recovery Leaderboard defaults to a collapsed summary (this month's and last month's leader + runner-up, name + count) and expands to its current stacked bar chart; (4) the Kit Users donut (Active vs Inactive) is deleted and replaced by a compact card showing Camera Kits and Kit Users counts, expanding to the existing Active Kit Users table with its filter and pagination. Dalton's comment is authoritative on top of that: exactly 2 rows of 4 cards with the hit-type cards kept together, and only ONE detail region open at a time page-wide — opening a new one REPLACES the previous, never compounds. Backyard's InsightPulse widget is the named reference for the card-toggle + detail-expansion mechanism. Every number the compact cards need is already computed by today's widgets (a cached 13-month series per metric); the only genuinely new data question is what "Kit Users" counts. The real risk in this ticket is not data — it is the interaction architecture (Clarity's dashboard is nine independently-mounted Livewire widget components, whereas Backyard's reference is one widget owning one Alpine scope) plus a set of unresolved layout/semantic decisions.

scope.summary: Rename the Dashboard page (header + nav label); restructure the six metric widgets, the Recovery Leaderboard, and the Kit Users area into a compact-card grid with ONE shared 'which detail is open' state (Backyard InsightPulse pattern); delete the KitStatusGraph donut; add Camera Kits + Kit Users totals. Reuse every existing month-bucketed query/cache path unchanged — no new ClickHouse query classes for the six metrics, no PG migrations, no CH schema changes. One new small aggregate is needed only if 'Kit Users' means distinct assigned users.

proposed_changes.change: getTitle() returns 'Company Metrics' AND add `protected static ?string $navigationLabel = 'Company Metrics';`
proposed_changes.reason: SETTLED (4/4 passes): the page header comes from the instance getTitle(); the sidebar label comes from the STATIC getNavigationLabel() fallback chain `static::$navigationLabel ?? static::$title ?? __('filament-panels::pages/dashboard.title')`, which this subclass never overrides — so renaming only getTitle() leaves 'Dashboard' in the sidebar. Sibling pages set $navigationLabel explicitly (Profile.php:24, ClientAnalytics.php:26, RecentChanges.php:18, KitUserRecoveries.php:41, ManageZones.php:38) — follow that convention. Do NOT edit lang/vendor/filament-panels/en/pages/dashboard.php (shared vendor-published file).

proposed_changes.change: Introduce the single shared 'which detail is open' state and restructure getFooterWidgets()/columnSpans for a 2x4 card grid.
proposed_changes.reason: getColumns()/getFooterWidgetsColumns() already return ['default'=>1,'md'=>2,'lg'=>4], so the page is already 4-wide at lg; only per-widget columnSpan (currently ['default'=>1,'lg'=>2], i.e. half-row) needs to shrink to a quarter-row. The shared open-state is what satisfies Dalton's one-at-a-time rule — see the architecture question.

proposed_changes.change: Add MTD / %-change / sparkline-series helpers ON TOP of the existing getMonthlyData()/getGraphLabels() without touching their month arithmetic.
proposed_changes.reason: SETTLED (4/4): getMonthlyData() already returns a cached 13-month series and getDescription() already renders 'Current Month / Last Month' — MTD is that last bucket and the prior-month comparator is the one before it. DEV-1927 (commit 4cdcf4117) fixed month bucketing by normalizing `now(tz)->startOfMonth()->subMonths($i)` (never `subMonths()->startOfMonth()`); DashboardMonthLabelsTest.php pins it. New code MUST reuse these helpers rather than re-deriving month math.

proposed_changes.change: Add a compact-card render path (label, MTD total, %-change, sparkline) and move the existing bar chart behind the expanded state. The ticket's names map 1:1 onto existing widgets — 'Repossessions' = RecoveryCounts (heading 'Recoveries'), 'Direct Historical Hits' = HistoricalHits (heading 'Historical Hits'). These are RELABELS, not new metrics.
proposed_changes.reason: SETTLED (4/4). The 4 hit widgets are thin wrappers over SharedHitStatsData, which batch-fetches all four hit-type columns from clarity.hit_stats_daily in ONE query — the compact cards must keep using that shared batch, not four separate queries.

proposed_changes.change: Add a collapsed-summary path yielding this-month leader+runner-up and last-month leader+runner-up (name + count) simultaneously; leave getData()/getOptions() untouched for the expanded stacked chart.
proposed_changes.reason: SETTLED (4/4): getDescription() already derives leader/runner-up for a single range, and RecoveryLeaderQuery already returns ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10 — so leader/runner-up are the first two entries. Collapsed view = the same derivation applied to two ranges (or the last two buckets of getMonthlyData(formatted:false)). No new query. NOTE the existing behavior conflict: getDescription() today switches range based on the page date filter, while the ticket specifies a fixed this-month/last-month pair — see open question.

proposed_changes.change: Unregister from Dashboard::getFooterWidgets() and delete the class; its dedicated test file must be deleted or repurposed in the same change.
proposed_changes.reason: AC: 'Kit Users donut chart is removed'. This is the only doughnut widget in the repo and its heading is literally 'Kit Users'. Deleting the test file needs explicit human approval per the repo rule (CLAUDE.md / PHPUnit rules: never remove tests without approval) — surfaced as a question.

proposed_changes.change: Add the compact summary (Camera Kits, Kit Users) in front of the existing table; the table, its filter, and pagination move into the expanded state UNCHANGED.
proposed_changes.reason: SETTLED (4/4) and constrained by Dalton ('exactly as it exists today, just moved into the expanded view'). IMPORTANT ticket-vs-code mismatch found by 3/4 passes: the ticket says the panel has a 'Value filter, Kit Name filter', but the widget actually has exactly ONE SelectFilter (key 'type', Active/Inactive, whose Filament-internal data key is 'value') and NO Kit Name text search (no column is ->searchable()). Also: this widget lists KIT rows via the ClickHouse Kit model — it holds no user data at all, which is why 'Kit Users' needs a definition.

proposed_changes.file: Kit Users count query (new, only if it means distinct assigned users)
proposed_changes.change: Two independent single-connection queries: resolve the org's kit ids on the `zod` connection, then `KitSettings::whereIn('kit_id', $ids)->whereNotNull('user_id')->distinct('user_id')->count()` on `platform`.
proposed_changes.reason: SETTLED (4/4) on the mechanism: App\Models\Kit is on the `zod` connection (Kit.php:59) and App\Models\KitSettings is on `platform` (KitSettings.php:25). A cross-connection `whereHas('settings')`/join silently returns 0 — never use one. Camera Kits reuses the existing kit-count pattern from KitStatusGraph.

proposed_changes.change: New Blade view(s) implementing the card grid + toggle + detail region, modeled on Backyard: one `x-data="{ open: null }"` scope, toggles doing `open = (open === key) ? null : key`, `x-show` + `x-collapse` detail region(s), and a server-computed inline SVG `<polyline>` sparkline (no JS chart library for the mini chart).
proposed_changes.reason: Dalton's explicit reference. Clarity has NO custom dashboard widget Blade views today (only resources/views/filament/widgets/placeholder.blade.php) — this UI is built new. The x-collapse plugin already ships inside vendor/filament/filament/dist/index.js, so no new JS dependency.

proposed_changes.reason: public/build is tracked in this repo and Tailwind v4 content-scans source via @source globs over app/Filament and resources/views/filament (theme.css:1-8) — new utility classes in the new Blade views do not exist in the compiled CSS until rebuilt. questions.q: Which 8 things fill the '2 rows of 4'? Recommended reading: the 6 metrics + the Recovery Leaderboard summary card + the Kit Users summary card = 8, laid out as row 1 = Scan Count, Repossessions, Recovery Leaderboard, Kit Users and row 2 = the 4 hit cards (which satisfies 'keep all hits together'). Confirm, or give the intended composition/order.
questions.answer: CONFIRMED (recommended composition). 8 cards = the 6 metrics + the Recovery Leaderboard summary + the Kit Users summary. HARD CONSTRAINT: all 4 hit cards must sit together in one row. Layout: row 1 = Scan Count | Repossessions | Recovery Leaderboard | Kit Users; row 2 = Live Hits | Staging Live Hits | Direct Historical Hits | Staging Historical Hits.

questions.q: Sparkline window and granularity: reuse the existing cached 13-month series (zero new queries), a shorter monthly slice (e.g. last 6 months), or a finer daily/weekly window (new bounded per-day queries — cheap against hit_stats_daily, which is already date-grain)?
questions.answer: Reuse each widget’s existing cached monthly series for its sparkline. No new sparkline queries.

questions.q: What does '% change vs prior period' compare? (a) MTD-so-far vs the FULL prior calendar month — free, already cached, but unfair early in the month; (b) MTD-so-far vs the same day-of-month range last month — apples-to-apples, one extra bounded query per metric; (c) trailing 30 days vs the prior 30 days.
questions.answer: MTD vs the SAME DAY-RANGE last month (apples-to-apples): on Aug 12 compare Aug 1-12 against Jul 1-12. Costs one extra bounded query per metric against the same pre-aggregated tables — accepted.

questions.q: Do the compact cards and the collapsed leaderboard respect the page's existing date filter (Today / Last 7 Days / This Month / Last Month), or are they always fixed to calendar this-month vs last-month regardless of it? Today every widget's description text follows that filter, so the ticket's fixed 'this month + last month' wording conflicts with existing behavior.
questions.answer: DELEGATED to the driver, recommendation accepted: the card headline number FOLLOWS the page date filter, and because DateTogglesFilter defaults to this_month (Dashboard.php:91 ->defaultDate(’this_month’)) the default view is exactly the MTD total the ticket specifies. The % change always compares the prior EQUIVALENT period for whatever range is selected. The collapsed Recovery Leaderboard is the exception: it stays fixed at this-month + last-month regardless of the filter, because it shows two months side by side and a filter of Today/Last 7d cannot express that.

questions.q: Does 'Kit Users' mean DISTINCT ASSIGNED USERS (platform.kit_settings.user_id — needs a new two-step cross-connection count) or is it a second view of the kit count? Code evidence: the widget titled 'Active Kit Users' today lists KIT names and holds no user data at all, so 'Kit User' has historically meant 'kit' on this dashboard.
questions.answer: Do NOT redefine Kit Users — use what already exists. Camera Kits = total kit count; Kit Users = ACTIVE kit users, i.e. the count already computed by the donut widget’s active() method (the same population the existing “Active Kit Users” list shows). No new cross-connection distinct-user query is needed, so the Kit/KitSettings connection hazard is avoided entirely.

questions.q: The ticket says the expanded panel keeps a 'Value filter' and a 'Kit Name filter', but the widget has only ONE Active/Inactive SelectFilter (whose internal data key is literally 'value') and no Kit Name search. Add a Kit Name filter as new work, or keep the panel exactly as it exists today (per your comment)?
questions.answer: Remove ONLY the Active/Inactive filter from the Kit Users panel. Keep the Kit Users card and its expanded paginated kit list. NOTE this is a deliberate AC change: the ticket said the expanded panel keeps “Value filter, Kit Name filter”; it will now expand to the paginated Active Kit Users list with NO filter. (Coherent with Q5: the panel is the active-kit-users list, so an active/inactive filter is redundant.)

questions.q: Where does the expanded detail render — inline inside the clicked card's own grid slot (accordion), or in ONE shared region below the whole card grid (what Backyard's InsightPulse does)?
questions.answer: ONE shared detail region below the whole card grid (the Backyard InsightPulse placement). Not inline in the clicked card’s grid slot.

questions.q: Architecture for the one-open-at-a-time rule. Clarity's dashboard is nine INDEPENDENT Filament widget Livewire components, so Backyard's single Alpine scope cannot coordinate them as-is. Options: (a) consolidate the 8 cards into one custom widget class owning one Alpine scope — closest to the Backyard reference; (b) keep separate widget classes and hold the expanded key as a property on the Dashboard PAGE, conditionally rendering the expanded chart — most Filament-native and gets true click-triggered lazy loading of the expensive chart query; (c) keep separate widgets and coordinate via a Livewire event. Which shape do you want? (If (c): it must use a NEW event name — 'refresh-dashboard' is already shared with ClientAnalytics, IndividualClientAnalytics and ClientTable.)
questions.answer: Option (b): hold the expanded key as a property on the Dashboard PAGE and render the expanded content conditionally. Most Filament-native, makes “replace, never compound” structural (one scalar key = at most one open region), and gives true click-triggered lazy loading of the expensive chart query. Explicitly NOT option (c), so the shared ‘refresh-dashboard’ event is left untouched.

questions.q: Approval to DELETE tests/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/KitStatusGraphTest.php along with the donut widget class it covers? Repo rule says test files are never removed without explicit approval.
questions.answer: APPROVED — delete tests/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/KitStatusGraphTest.php together with the KitStatusGraph donut widget class.

questions.q: Are the ticket's metric names relabels of existing widgets — 'Repossessions' = RecoveryCounts (heading 'Recoveries'), 'Direct Historical Hits' = HistoricalHits (heading 'Historical Hits')?
questions.answer: Yes. RecoveryCounts queries the Recovery model (repossession events) and HistoricalHits maps to hit_stats_daily.historical_hit_count (HitTypeEnum::Historical = 'H'), the non-staging counterpart of Staging_Historical = 'Z'. These are relabels, not new metrics.

questions.q: Are the hit-type codes as assumed (Live='L', Historical='H', Staging Live='S', Staging Historical='Z')?
questions.answer: Confirmed in app/Enums/HitTypeEnum.php:20-30, and they map 1:1 onto hit_stats_daily's live_hit_count / historical_hit_count / staging_live_hit_count / staging_historical_hit_count columns — no new hit-type filtering logic needed.

questions.q: Does this change require `npm run build` and a committed public/build update?
questions.answer: Yes for CSS. public/build is tracked, and Tailwind v4 @source-scans app/Filament + resources/views/filament, so new utility classes in the new Blade views need a rebuild. No new Vite entrypoint or JS dependency is needed — Alpine's x-collapse already ships in vendor/filament/filament/dist/index.js. Remember to revert the CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/.junie/boost.json churn `npm run build` causes before committing.

questions.q: Is RecoveryLeaderQuery's LIMIT 10 enough for leader + runner-up?
questions.answer: Yes — the query is already ORDER BY total DESC, so leader and runner-up are its first two entries. No query change.

notes: SETTLED — rename blast radius is tiny: a whole-repo grep for hardcoded 'Dashboard' string literals across app/, resources/, tests/ found exactly ONE (Dashboard.php:35). Every other 'Dashboard' reference is the class/route (Dashboard::getUrl()), unaffected by a label change. Page::getBreadcrumbs() returns [] absent a cluster, so no breadcrumb string exists.

SETTLED — DEV-1927 (commit 4cdcf4117) and 'Fix Recovery Leaderboard plotting months under wrong labels' (commit b2f0f7ea2) hardened the month math in DashboardWidget/SharedHitStatsData/ScanCount/RecoveryLeader. Reuse getMonthlyData()/getGraphLabels() verbatim; reintroducing `subMonths($i)->startOfMonth()` reproduces the Feb-skip/Mar-duplicate bug. b2f0f7ea2's getData() positional-alignment fix has NO regression test — worth adding one while touching this code.
SETTLED — cross-connection gotcha: Kit is on `zod`, KitSettings on `platform`; a whereHas/join across them silently returns 0. Materialize kit ids first, then a whereIn on the platform side.

SETTLED (backstop finding) — the Livewire event 'refresh-dashboard' is NOT private to this page: it is dispatched/listened by app/Filament/Pages/ClientAnalytics.php:166, app/Filament/Pages/IndividualClientAnalytics.php:55,191 and app/Filament/Widgets/Client/ClientTable.php:46. If expansion state is coordinated by event, it must use a NEW distinct event name. Likewise DateTogglesFilter is shared with 5 resources + both client analytics pages — do not change its contract.

SETTLED (backstop finding) — the 25 out-of-inventory references to `Dashboard` are all route-based redirects (CustomLoginPage, ClientAuthenticate, ClientMiddleware, LoginResponse) using Dashboard::getUrl(); a title/nav-label rename cannot break them, and no test asserts the title text today.

SETTLED — Filament v5 widgets are LAZY by default (vendor/filament/support/src/Concerns/CanBeLazy.php:9) and none of these widgets override it. Backyard's reference detail panels, by contrast, are plain <livewire:...> tags that mount EAGERLY and are only CSS-hidden — so a literal port would pre-run every expanded chart's query on page load. If click-triggered loading is wanted, that is a deliberate DIVERGENCE from the Backyard reference (and option (b) in Q8 gets it naturally).

SETTLED — Backyard reference mechanism, read end-to-end: ONE `x-data="{ open: null }"` scope wraps the whole tile grid; each tile's toggle does `open = (open === key) ? null : key` (single-open enforced by construction, no extra logic); detail panels are `x-show` + `x-collapse` divs BELOW the grid; the sparkline is a server-computed inline SVG <polyline> (no chart library). What ports: the state shape, the toggle idiom, the SVG sparkline. What does NOT port: the single-widget scope (Clarity has nine widgets), the eager detail mounting, and Backyard's hand-rolled vanilla Chart.js expanded charts — Clarity should keep Filament's native, already-tested ChartWidget for the expanded bar charts.

SETTLED — the 4 hit widgets share ONE batched ClickHouse fetch via SharedHitStatsData/HitStatsBatchQuery. The compact cards must keep using that batch; four independent per-card queries would quadruple the ClickHouse round-trips.

SETTLED — data hygiene to preserve: hit_stats_daily is read with FINAL (dedup), and recovery_scans/recoveries are read with explicit `_peerdb_is_deleted = 0` CDC soft-delete filters. Any new derived query must keep both.

SETTLED — no PG migration and no ClickHouse schema change is required. All reads are org-scoped, bounded-range, deterministically ordered against existing pre-aggregated tables, consistent with the CH knowledge card. PG stays source of truth; CH counts may lag by CDC latency exactly as they do today.

SETTLED — Clarity has NO custom dashboard-widget Blade views today (only resources/views/filament/widgets/placeholder.blade.php); all nine widgets use Filament's default views. The compact-card UI is genuinely new construction, with no in-repo precedent to copy — hence Dalton's cross-repo pointer.

DISAGREEMENT RESOLVED BY ARITHMETIC — one candidate claimed 6 metrics + leaderboard + kit users = 7 and inferred a missing 8th card. It is 6 + 1 + 1 = 8, which is exactly Dalton's '2 rows of 4' with the 4 hit cards forming one row. Recorded as the recommended default in Q1 rather than silently adopted.

DISAGREEMENT RESOLVED — one pass concluded no `npm run build` was needed (correct that no new Vite ENTRYPOINT is required) while three concluded it was (correct that Tailwind must re-scan for new utility classes). Both are true at different layers: CSS rebuild yes, JS entrypoint no.

PROCESS — the repo runs PHPUnit (not Pest) and has no JS test runner, so the one-open-at-a-time interaction is best pinned by a Livewire/page test for the state transition plus a human/agent browser check for the visual collapse.

data_impact.mv_or_cdc_implications: No writes, no new materialized views, no CDC pipeline changes. Every CH table read here is already the data source for today's widgets — PeerDB-CDC-replicated from Postgres or an aggregate built from that stream — so counts may lag PG by CDC latency exactly as they do now. hit_stats_daily is read with FINAL and recovery_scans/recoveries with `_peerdb_is_deleted = 0`; both must be preserved by any new derived query. New sparkline/%-change work should read the existing pre-aggregated rollups, never re-scan hits_hot/hits_cold.

derivation_log.query_shape: SELECT toStartOfMonth(date), sum(<hit_type>_count) FROM clarity.hit_stats_daily FINAL WHERE org_id = ? AND date BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
derivation_log.aggregate_result: 13-element month→int map per hit type, deterministically ordered
derivation_log.why: Existing batched query behind all four hit metrics. Its last bucket IS the MTD figure and the previous bucket the prior-month comparator, so the compact cards need no new query.

derivation_log.query_shape: SELECT toStartOfMonth(scan_hour), uniqExactMerge(scan_count) FROM clarity.scan_report_hourly WHERE org_id = ? AND scan_hour BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT k.name, round(sum(kit_count/total_count),2) AS total FROM (per-kit share over clarity.recovery_scans FINAL, scoped by clarity.recoveries.org_id + repo_date range, _peerdb_is_deleted = 0) sub JOIN clarity.kits k GROUP BY k.id, k.name HAVING total > 0 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10
derivation_log.param_classes: org_id: int; bounded month range, evaluated per month
derivation_log.aggregate_result: name→float map, already sorted leader-first, capped at 10
derivation_log.why: Existing leaderboard query. The collapsed summary is the top two entries of the this-month and last-month results — no new SQL.

qa_hint.seed_scenario: One org with an admin user. Seed clarity.hit_stats_daily rows for the current and prior month across all four hit types with distinct totals (so MTD, %-change and sparkline are non-flat), plus scan_report_hourly equivalents for Scan Count and recovery rows for Repossessions. Seed clarity.recovery_scans/recoveries attributing recoveries to 2–3 named kits in BOTH this month and last month, with a different leader/runner-up ordering per month so a range mix-up is caught.
